## 🔍 Muki Daily Digest - Research & Evidence Dossier

**Current Date Context**: 2026-09-21 (Asia/Shanghai)

### 1. [Feminist Structure Signal]

*   **Exhibition Title (English)**: Japanese Women Photographers: From 1950s to Now
*   **Proposed Chinese Title**: 伦敦摄影家画廊《日本女性摄影师：自1950年代至今》特展：以 27 位创作者的 200 余幅作品重构东亚现代影像史中的女性线索
*   **Specific Source URL**: [https://thephotographersgallery.org.uk/whats-on/japanese-women-photographers-1950s-now](https://thephotographersgallery.org.uk/whats-on/japanese-women-photographers-1950s-now)
*   **Publication / Event Date**: June 24, 2026 (Exhibition runs from June 24 through September 27, 2026; current signal is chosen as this landmark show enters its final closing week)
*   **Verified Facts**:
    *   **Organizers**: Curated by Lesley A. Martin, Takeuchi Mariko (竹内万里子), and Pauline Vermare, in collaboration with the Aperture Foundation and Les Rencontres d'Arles. The London presentation is co-curated with Taous Dahmani.
    *   **Exhibition Scope**: Spans all floors of The Photographers' Gallery (TPG) in London, presenting over 200 photographs, videos, installations, and rare photobooks by 27 Japanese women photographers.
    *   **Participating Artists**: Includes pioneering figures and modern masters such as Yamazawa Eiko (山沢栄子), Tokiwa Toyoko (常盤とよ子), Ishiuchi Miyako (石内都), Ishikawa Mao (石川真生), Kawauchi Rinko (川内伦子), Nagashima Yurie (长岛有里枝), Ninagawa Mika (蜷川实花), Shiga Lieko (志贺理江子), Komatsu Hiroko (小松浩子), and Yanagi Miwa (やなぎみわ).
    *   **Historical / Structural Frame**: Traces how women's photographic careers were shaped by sociopolitical shifts in postwar Japan, notably punctuated by the passage of the Equal Employment Opportunity Law in 1985 (implemented in 1986). It features a physical restaging of Komatsu Hiroko's "Broiler Space" (originally a bi-weekly rental-space installation in Tokyo, 2010–2011, packing black-and-white prints of industrial sites from floor to ceiling).
    *   **Publication Connection**: Conceived alongside the landmark Aperture publication *I'm So Happy You Are Here: Japanese Women Photographers 1950s to Now* (2024).
*   **Relevance to Muki**: Crucial case of structural feminist curating and archival recovery in East Asia. It charts the historical transition from postwar street realism to 1990s domestic intimacies ("girly photo" era) and contemporary conceptualism. The restaging of Komatsu's floor-to-ceiling physical print installation highlights how tactile and spatial photographic materiality can challenge male-dominated gallery traditions.
*   **Duplication Assessment**: **New** (Never featured in the recent 7-issue context).

### 2. [Visual Culture Signal]

*   **Exhibition Title (English)**: A Life with the Mountain: Wang Wusheng's Vintage Photographs
*   **Proposed Chinese Title**: 北京三影堂摄影艺术中心举办《一人一山：汪芜生摄影原作展》：由巫鸿策划，系统呈现这位黑白山水摄影先驱的暗房银盐遗产
*   **Specific Source URL**: [https://www.threeshadows.cn](https://www.threeshadows.cn)
*   **Publication / Event Date**: September 5, 2026 (Exhibition runs from September 5 to November 8, 2026)
*   **Verified Facts**:
    *   **Curatorial Team**: Curated by renowned art historian and professor Wu Hung (巫鸿), with artistic direction by RongRong (荣荣) and production by Zhi Yong (至永).
    *   **Significance**: This is the first solo exhibition of the late photographer Wang Wusheng (汪芜生, 1945–2018) since his passing in 2018.
    *   **Content**: Features nearly 100 representative black-and-white gelatin silver vintage prints (黑白银盐原作) of his iconic *Mt. Huangshan* (黄山) series, spanning the 1970s through the 1990s.
    *   **Aesthetic & Technique**: Wang made nearly 100 trips to Huangshan starting in 1974. Unlike commercial "pictorialist" photographers of the era, he did not label peaks or waterfalls, choosing instead to abstract the landscape. He spent decades in the darkroom, refining chemical processes to achieve deep, velvety black textures that evoke the traditional Chinese ink-painting concept "ink divides into five colors" (墨分五色).
    *   **Institution & Prep**: Developed in joint coordination with Three Shadows +3 Gallery and the Wang Wusheng Legacy Executive Committee (汪芜生遗产执行委员会).
*   **Relevance to Muki**: Directly links to photography archives, physical print materiality, and East Asian image history. It provides a rare reference for darkroom archaeology, showing how a modern technology (silver halide gelatin printing) was chemically modified to translate classical Eastern philosophies into physical images, challenging standard "scenic" photography through structural, abstract ink aesthetics.
*   **Duplication Assessment**: **New** (Never featured in the recent 7-issue context).

### 3. [China / East Asia Signal]

*   **Exhibition Title (English)**: La Dénivelée: Huang Jingyao's Solo Exhibition at Fotografiska Shanghai
*   **Proposed Chinese Title**: 上海 Fotografiska 举办黄静耀个展《La Dénivelée》：当坏道内存卡成为“摩斯密码”，以数码媒介考古与几何装置重绘粤港大湾区与纽约城市记忆
*   **Specific Source URL**: [https://www.fotografiska.com/shanghai/](https://www.fotografiska.com/shanghai/)
*   **Publication / Event Date**: September 18, 2026 (Exhibition runs from September 18 to December 6, 2026)
*   **Verified Facts**:
    *   **Artist**: Huang Jingyao (黄静耀), visual artist born in Guangzhou, based between New York and Guangzhou; graduated from the School of Visual Arts (SVA).
    *   **Featured Series**: Includes three bodies of work: *Chaotic Data Fences*, *Baraka*, and *Cityscape*.
    *   **Mechanism & Workflow**: The series began in 2021 when Huang, isolated at home in Guangzhou, photographed daily sunrises and sunsets from her rooftop. She later discovered that the data on her old SD memory card had become severely corrupted (坏道/数据损毁). The corrupted card split her images into proportional bands, casting yellow and blue blocks and fracturing the architectural structures. Instead of discarding the files, she treated this digital glitch as a "Morse code" for the fragility of memory. She sliced these distorted photographs into geometric units and physically rebuilt them into layered physical installations using acrylic and collage.
    *   **Conceptual Title**: The title *La Dénivelée* refers to the writings of French theorist Hubert Damisch, who argued that photography does not merely record history but constantly unsettles and ruptures it.
*   **Relevance to Muki**: An excellent study in digital media archaeology and physical-digital workflows. It demonstrates how "technological failure" (corrupted hardware data) can be re-routed through physical fabrication to give tactile, sculptural form to the precarious and non-linear nature of digital visual storage and urban memory.
*   **Duplication Assessment**: **New** (Never featured in the recent 7-issue context).

### 4. [AI Research / Creative Tech Signal]

*   **Product Title (English)**: ComfyUI v0.37.0: Native Qwen-Image 2.1 and MoGe 3 Support
*   **Proposed Chinese Title**: ComfyUI 发布 v0.37.0 更新：原生合并 Qwen-Image 2.1 视觉语言大模型与 MoGe 3 高精三维几何估计
*   **Specific Source URL**: [https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI)
*   **Publication / Event Date**: September 21, 2026
*   **Verified Facts**:
    *   **Core Updates**: 
        1.  **Qwen-Image 2.1 Native Support**: Integrates Alibaba's latest high-performance vision-language model into the core, offering three official workflow templates for native visual tagging, question-answering, and structural image parsing.
        2.  **MoGe 3 Integration**: Adds native MoGe 3 multi-scale geometry estimation, which refines a coarse point map on a sparse voxel shell. This preserves fine-detail structures (like thin branches, leaves, wires, or hair) that traditional image-space depth decoders typically blur out.
        3.  **Speculative Decoding**: Speeds up the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8 text encoders with speculative decoding, lowering inference latency.
        4.  **Auto Fast-Disk**: Automatically detects NVMe drives and enables the `--fast-disk` loading flag to drastically reduce model loading times from local storage.
        5.  **Default Sizes**: Raises the default size of the Empty Latent Image node to 1024x1024 to accommodate modern larger diffusion models.
*   **Relevance to Muki**: This update materially shifts local research, generation, and multi-view curation workflows. Integrating Qwen-Image 2.1 allows locally run agentic workflows to interpret, label, and index image archives semantically without sending data to external APIs. MoGe 3 represents a major leap in high-fidelity 3D geometry reconstruction from single 2D photographs, allowing digital and spatial designers to maintain physical structures with unprecedented structural accuracy.
*   **Duplication Assessment**: **Follow-up** (This is a significant core update following our ComfyUI tracking in Issue 2026-09-18.md, specifically representing the direct, native integration of high-fidelity point-map refinement and advanced localized vision-language models).

### 5. [Archive / Long Read / Opportunity]

*   **Opportunity Title (English)**: MoriCAF Curator Residency Program 2027 Open Call
*   **Proposed Chinese Title**: 森美术文化基金会启动 2027 年度策展人驻留项目公募：资助全球策展人赴日深耕当代艺术生态与学术网络
*   **Specific Source URL**: [https://mori-caf.jp/en/curator-residency-program-2027-application-and-guidelines/](https://mori-caf.jp/en/curator-residency-program-2027-application-and-guidelines/)
*   **Publication / Event Date**: September 11, 2026 (Application Period: September 11, 2026 – October 31, 2026, 18:00 JST)
*   **Verified Facts**:
    *   **Organizer**: Mori Contemporary Art Foundation (MoriCAF) based in Tokyo, Japan.
    *   **Eligible Candidates**: Curators residing outside Japan who have 5 or more years of professional curatorial experience in contemporary art and are fluent in English or Japanese.
    *   **Stipend & Coverage**: MoriCAF provides full round-trip economy airfare to Narita or Haneda, continuous housing in a private single-room serviced apartment (equipped with a kitchen and breakfast included), and up to JPY 200,000 in research project expenses.
    *   **Duration**: 1 to 3 months (maximum 90 days) between April 2027 and March 2028. Selected residents (3 to 4 per year) must present their research findings and submit a written report before departure.
    *   **Evaluation Priority**: The international jury includes 6 major global museum directors (e.g., Mami Kataoka of Mori Art Museum, Glenn D. Lowry of MoMA, Frances Morris of Tate Modern, Suhanya Raffel of M+, Eugene Tan of SAM). Priority is given to curatorial proposals directly connected to concrete, future planned exhibitions/collaborations over general exploratory trips.
*   **Relevance to Muki**: A prestigious and highly structured regional curatorial opportunity in East Asia. It offers complete funding to support deep scholarly research on archive building, studio visits, and institutional networking, putting selected curators in direct touch with Japan’s leading art spaces, artists, and alternative platforms.
*   **Duplication Assessment**: **New** (Never featured in the recent 7-issue context).
